items.title: Flat pullback along a vector bundle is an isomorphism on Chow groups
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter chow.tex (Chow Homology and Chern Classes)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file chow.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that pullback along the vector bundle associated to a finite locally free sheaf of rank r is an isomorphism from the Chow groups of the base onto the Chow groups of the bundle, shifted by r (statement lines 7061-7075, tag 02TY). Surjectivity is a citation of the affine space fibration lemma, but injectivity needs a real construction: the vector bundle is realised as the complement of the zero scheme of a carefully chosen section of the projective bundle of E direct sum the structure sheaf, a vanishing class is shown to come from the divisor, that divisor class is expanded through the projective space bundle formula, and the resulting expression is contradicted by the vanishing of the top cap on a bundle of one higher rank. The injectivity argument is the substance, so the claim is H2.
